newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-BENSON AND HEDGES CUP RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BENSON AND HEDGES CUP RESULTS.

text.p: Results in Benson and Hedges Cup
(50 overs) cricket matches on Tuesday:
At Northampton: Northamptonshire beat Scotland by 5 wickets.
Scotland 160-9 in 50 overs. Northamptonshire 165-4 in 32.4
overs.
At Edgbaston: Yorkshire beat Warwickshire by 5 wickets.
Warwickshire 233-8 in 50 overs. Yorkshire 237-5 in 46.3 overs
(M.Vaughan 88, D.Lehmann 67).
At Walsall: Lancashire beat Minor Counties by 35 runs.
Lancashire 210-7 in 50 overs. Minor Counties 175 in 43.3 overs.
At Glamorgan: Glamorgan beat Ireland by 6 wickets. Ireland
202-9 in 50 overs (W.Cronje 85). Glamorgan 203-4 in 30.3 overs
(M.Maynard 50).
At Derby: Derbyshire beat Worcestershire by 20 runs.
Derbyshire 231 in 49.4 overs (K.Barnett 59, V.Clarke 52;
D.Leatherdale 4-33). Worcestershire 211 all out in 48-5 overs
(T.Moody 77).
At Durham: Leicestershire beat Durham by 19 runs.
Leicestershire 287-4 in 50 overs (A.Habib 111, V.Wells 90).
Durham, set a revised target of 282 in 48 overs after rain
interruption, 263-9 in 48 overs (J.Morris 62, N.Speak 59).
